crossRefs.note: The Philistines took God’s ark, and brought it into the house of Dagon and set it by Dagon.
The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El;
He said, “What cities are these which you have given me, my brother?” He called them the land of Cabul to this day.

translations.web: It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Iphtah El northward to Beth Emek and Neiel. It went out to Cabul on the left hand,
translations.bsb: then turned eastward toward Beth-dagon, touched Zebulun and the Valley of Iphtah-el, and went north to Beth-emek and Neiel, passing Cabul on the left.
translations.kjv: And turneth toward the sunrising to Bethdagon, and reacheth to Zebulun, and to the valley of Jiphthahel toward the north side of Bethemek, and Neiel, and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand,
translations.asv: and it turned toward the sunrising to Beth-dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Iphtah-el northward to Beth-emek and Neiel; and it went out to Cabul on the left hand,
